Windows blastn includes unmodified x64 release C runtime DLLs from the build
machine's licensed Visual Studio installation (VC/Redist/MSVC). These files
remain proprietary Microsoft components, not HiCT MIT-licensed source code.
Their exact paths and SHA-256 values are recorded in blast-smoke.json.
Redistribution is subject to the Visual Studio license terms and REDIST list:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution
https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/
Application-local deployment follows:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files
Only release x64 CRT files are copied; debug runtimes are never distributed.
Windows 10/11 provides the Universal CRT as an OS component. App-local DLLs
are updated with HiCT packages, not by a central VC redistributable installer.
